subject: Future Tech
title: Cameras and Computer Vision
description: A micro-lesson that makes Cameras and Computer Vision usable.

buildup.text: Cameras capture color, texture, and detail that lidar misses.

discovery.text: Deep learning lets cameras understand scenes: that's a pedestrian, that's a stop sign, that car is merging right.

twist.text: Cameras struggle in rain, fog, and glare. Unlike lidar, they depend on lighting conditions.

climax.text: Tesla argues humans drive with eyes alone, so cameras suffice. Critics say humans also have judgment that cameras lack.

punchline.text: Cameras see like us. The debate is whether that's enough.

quiz.question: Why does Tesla use only cameras instead of lidar?
options: Lidar is illegal in some states
They argue cameras are sufficient, like human eyes
Cameras are more accurate than lidar
